title: Narrow vs Wide Transformations in Spark

scenes.line1: Why do some Spark jobs run slow?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why some Spark jobs crawl while others fly? Let's talk shuffles and transformations.
Narrow transformations, like map or filter, use data from just one partition. Wide transformations, like groupBy or join, need data from many partitions.

scenes.label: Shuffle
scenes.sub: Shuffles move data across the cluster and slow things down.
scenes.say: A shuffle happens when wide transformations move data across the cluster. This can really slow your job down.
For example, mapping a column is narrow. Grouping and counting triggers a wide transformation and a shuffle.

scenes.question: Does every transformation cause a shuffle?
scenes.right: No, only wide transformations like join or groupBy cause shuffles.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: Not every transformation causes a shuffle. Only wide ones do.
